verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a consumer and business phone service that handles call records, voicemails and transcriptions, so asking whether customer data is kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no privacy policy, data-use statement or AI-training opt-out; it covers only hardware, plans, porting and calling features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
